units.title: Paired fifth-power divisibility modulo a sum of squares
units.statement: For positive integers m,n, both (m^5+n)/(m^2+n^2) and (n^5+m)/(m^2+n^2) are integers only at (1,1). First the common divisor of m,n must be 1. With D=m^2+n^2, the two congruences force m^8=-1 and m^24=1 modulo D, so D divides 2.
steps: Factor out gcd(m,n) and reduce both numerators modulo that gcd
Use n=-m^5 and n^2=-m^2 modulo D
Cancel invertible m to derive contradictory eighth and twenty-fourth powers unless D=2
